notes: Selected 2026-11-14 (owner decision after a same-seed bake-off of SDXL and five Qwen-Image candidates, test-results/qwen-image-bakeoff-20261114): Qwen-Image-2512 at full bf16 precision with lightx2v's Qwen-Image-2512-Lightning 8-step LoRA (V1.0, bf16), 8 steps at CFG 1, the Qwen2.5-VL 7B fp8-scaled text encoder and the Qwen-Image VAE, from Comfy-Org's repack. Run by both picture backends (SwarmUI's ComfyUI on gpu-1 and comfyui-gpu0) with the fixed workflow apps/base/shared-api/qwen-image-workflow.json. Staged onto the local NVMe creative-models volume (Image/), not the NAS ai-models volume: ComfyUI --fast-disk streams the 41 GB model from disk. Stage with infrastructure/ai-stack/models/stage-video.py. Licences: Qwen-Image-2512 (card metadata), the Comfy-Org repack and the lightx2v LoRA are Apache 2.0. Qwen-Image-2.1 was not considered for use: its Qwen Research License limits use to research or evaluation.
